collection.title: Ferrari F8 Tributo 2019 to 2023 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Ferrari F8 Tributo 2019 - 2023 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
